content.text:
Main’s “lint” job is failing because commit `9fe85d6` (#12859) changed documentation sources but didn’t commit the regenerated `docs/public/llms.txt`.

CI successfully runs `mise run render`, then the “assert render produces no diff” step detects changes including:

- `Guides` → `Start Here`
- Updated Getting Started, Walkthrough, and Dev Tools descriptions

So the actual `mise run lint` step never executes—it is skipped after the render guard fails.

Fix: run `mise run render`, commit the resulting `docs/public/llms.txt`, and push. [Failed job](https://github.com/jdx/mise/actions/runs/34010428299/job/101425545869)
